hooks.name: Lint and format Python on save
hooks.description: Keeps code aligned with tech.md: ruff format + ruff check --fix whenever the agent saves a Python file.

action.command: uv run ruff format -q . && uv run ruff check --fix -q .

hooks.name: Run property-based tests when ledger changes
hooks.description: Any edit to the money logic re-runs the hypothesis correctness properties from the spec.
